name: qfd_ucie_gearbox_r10-r10-COMMIT
purpose: Harden the r10 block-stage UCIe gearbox leaf; measure area and TT/FF at the conservative common 833.333 ps envelope.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_ucie_six_five u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/physical/ot_qfd_ucie_six_five.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: gearbox_r10_mut_wrong_word
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/mut2 && python3 -c "import sys,subprocess;sys.path.insert(0,'tools');import qwen_ucie_six_five_bench as b;from pathlib import Path;o=Path('{RUN}/mut2');h=o/'harness.cpp';h.write_text(b.CPP);subprocess.run(['verilator','--cc','--exe','--build','-Wno-fatal','-Wno-WIDTH','-Wno-TIMESCALEMOD','-Wno-MULTIDRIVEN','--top-module','tb_qfd_ucie_six_five','-GMUT=2','--Mdir',str(o/'obj'),'rtl/physical/ot_qfd_ucie_six_five.sv','rtl/test/tb_qfd_ucie_six_five.sv',str(h),'-j','4'],check=True);r=subprocess.run([str(o/'obj/Vtb_qfd_ucie_six_five')]);sys.exit(r.returncode)"

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_ucie_gearbox_r10/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_ucie_gearbox_r10/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_ucie_gearbox_r10 --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_ucie_six_five  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: r10 replaces the r9 direct 1.2 GHz core <-> 1 GHz FDI gearbox (ordinary STA relation 166.7 ps, slack -48..-633 ps pre-placement) with a 200 MHz block stage: 4x3588 payload FF (r9: 5x3588), constant 19 core edges (r9: 24), same 1043-bit 4-of-5 FDI beat calendar. Gate 1e991bc08 WARNs fixed structurally: every boundary input registered before check logic (beat 3 captured full width, padding OR on registered bits; PHY valid pin flop), registered one-hot stage/beat enables replace binary decodes (2,088-load decode nets), outline 86.4x216 (util ~0.43; height fixed by the 2,089-pin FDI face). Gate d207fd319 FAIL DPL-0038 at util 0.55 after timing repair buffered 600-load select nets: stage/read selects now three copies (199 bits each) and FDI beat enables five copies (<=209 bits each), all <=256 loads, copies cross-checked by the fault logic.
